Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.nativewindow.x11

Class VerifyX11Extensions

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.nativewindow.x11.VerifyX11Extensions
public final class VerifyX11Extensions extends Object
Stage 0 diagnostic for the X11 compositing integration.

Connects to the running X server (via $DISPLAY, defaulting to :0) and negotiates every X extension that the lg3d compositor path needs. Prints the client-requested and server-returned version for each, and exits with a non-zero status if any required extension is missing.

Extensions verified:

  • Composite - redirect window rendering into offscreen pixmaps (via X11CompositeExt).
  • DAMAGE - notifications when a redirected window repaints (via X11DamageExt).
  • XFIXES - cursor-shape notifications and region primitives (via X11FixesExt, already in-tree).
  • XTEST - synthetic input injection for forwarding lg3d 3D picking results back to real X11 apps (via Escher's XTest).
  • SHAPE - non-rectangular window support (via Escher's Shape).
  • MIT-SHM - shared-memory pixel transfer for fast readback (via X11ShmExt).

Invoked by the Gradle task :lg3d-core:verifyX11Extensions. Requires a running X server; on a headless CI machine the task should be skipped rather than failed.
